account_key_path.description: Absolute path to the RSA account private key (4096-bit recommended). Must be generated once and reused for all renewals.

domain_csr_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the certificate signing request (CSR) file for your domains. If not provided, domains list is used instead.

acme_directory_url.description: ACME CA directory URL. Use 'https://acme-staging-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory' for testing (to avoid rate limits).

challenge_path.description: File system path where ACME challenge files will be written and served from (must match web server config).

webroot_path.description: Web server's document root directory. The `.well-known/acme-challenge` subpath must be publicly accessible from here.

renew_before_days.description: Renew certificates if they expire within this many days. Lower values increase renewals, higher values risk expiry.

challenge_retries.description: Number of times to retry the ACME challenge validation before failing.

challenge_retry_delay.description: Seconds to wait between challenge validation retries.

post_hook_cmd.description: Shell command to run after successful certificate issuance (e.g., to reload web server). Leave empty to skip.

post_hook_comment.default: Note: post_hook command must be valid shell code and handle errors gracefully.
post_hook_comment.description: Placeholder for comment explaining post_hook usage.

domains.description: List of primary domains (CN) to include in the certificate. Use only if domain_csr is not provided.

name.description: Primary domain (must be DNS-resolvable and publicly accessible).

alt_names.description: List of Subject Alternative Names (SANs) for this domain.

items.description: A subdomain or additional domain to include.
